data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 夏日祭的和服
data.description: 特殊分支。她穿着不习惯的和服站在捞金鱼摊前，袖子总是滑下来露出整截手臂；捞破纸网后急得直跺脚，所有情绪都写在脸上。
data.action: 一手收住浴衣袖口，盯着破掉的纸网懊恼地轻轻跺脚。
data.promptProse: Sagiri Izumi stands at the goldfish stall in a properly wrapped pale-blue floral yukata, lifting the broad sleeve clear of her arm as she examines a broken paper net. Her frustration shows openly, one sandal tapping the ground below the pink obi. The medium portrait includes basin rim and adjacent nets. Soft daylight reveals damp paper fibers and sleeve flowers, with fish shadows moving beneath the reflective surface and gentler shade under the counter.
